description: Iceflower answers questions about retail merchants and their customers from a large North American consumer transaction panel: revenue and growth, store footprints, RFM customer segments, cross-shopping, retention, local buyer profiles, and shopping-centre rankings. Every tool is read-only and returns the same numbers the Iceflower web app shows the signed-in account.

defaultPrompt: What are Nike customers shopping for in NYC
How many Netflix subscribers are still active after 12 month?
What are the biggest competitors of Costco in LA?
